sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r16/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks row 26 and Internal Quality Checks row 26 annotation)
evidence: Built a requirement -> criterion map from instruction.md and the six notes against the 55 criteria (1 render gate, 2 constraints gate, 43 functional, 6 polish, 3 visual; counts re-derived by grep). Every stated product behaviour has at least one criterion. behaviour.md:3 (fresh isolated run, html replaces document, nothing carries over, syntax error keeps draft, console order, one-based error lines incl. whole-file HTML line and unhandled rejections, output before failure kept) -> cw_basic_run_output, cw_html_preview, cw_run_starts_fresh_document, cw_error_message_and_line, cw_console_levels_in_order, cw_promise_rejection_message_and_line, cw_output_before_failure_kept. behaviour.md:5 (last-good picture, reason, five-second budget, fresh budget after interaction, later valid Run) -> cw_last_good_recovery, cw_time_limit_recovery, cw_interaction_starts_fresh_budget. behaviour.md:7 -> cw_stop_cancels_pending_work, cw_newer_run_supersedes. behaviour.md:9 -> gate cw_shared_saved_record, cw_save_reload_restart, cw_stale_save_refused, cw_stale_save_keeps_draft. behaviour.md:11 -> cw_live_library_update, cw_live_update_keeps_editing_state, cw_newer_revision_notice_keeps_draft. behaviour.md:13 -> cw_history_restore_adds_revision, cw_restore_request_repeat_safe. security.md:3,5 -> cw_preview_isolation (parent page, library, origin storage, own-route and outside fetch), cw_dynamic_code_refused (five forms plus harmless-string control); 'Save source as text' -> cw_save_reload_restart (string with HTML tag, ampersand, eval). ui.md:3 -> gate cw_custom_document_surface. ui.md:5 -> cw_custom_typing_and_line_join, cw_caret_navigation_and_line_numbers, cw_grapheme_navigation_and_deletion, cw_caret_kept_in_view. ui.md:7 -> cw_mouse_selection, cw_selection_replace_and_paste_undo, cw_long_line_editing, cw_block_indent_undo. ui.md:9 -> cw_multi_caret_typing_atomic (both modifiers, slow burst), cw_multi_caret_delete, cw_same_line_carets, cw_undo_restores_caret, cw_replace_all_atomic (visible Undo/Redo), polish cw_undo_redo_availability; 'already formatted ... adds no Undo step' is caught by cw_js_format_semantics_and_undo (second Format, then ONE Undo must restore the original). ui.md:11 -> cw_find_forward_backward_wrap, cw_replace_current, cw_replace_all_atomic, cw_replace_self_containing_text. ui.md:13 -> cw_js_semantic_coloring, cw_html_semantic_coloring. ui.md:15 -> cw_js_format_semantics_and_undo, cw_html_format_semantics_and_undo, cw_format_error_keeps_draft. ui.md:17 -> polish cw_controls_keyboard_and_focus, cw_controls_feedback_and_labels, cw_focus_returns_to_code, cw_unsaved_marker, cw_narrow_width_usable. overview.md:3,5 -> cw_visual_workspace_layout plus the functional set. integration.md launch, port, health, DB_PATH and restart on the same database are exercised by tests/test.sh (lines 48,109,136,165) and restart_app, not by a criterion; SQLite itself is not browser-observable (REVIEW_POLICY 'A browser exchange cannot prove SQLite'). Evidence hashes of run_golden.sh and results editor/runtime/polish/restart.json recomputed and match the index; the scripted golden results list every criterion id as true, so no criterion id is orphaned. No configured judge run exists for these bytes; this row is a static mapping and does not depend on one. NOTES (partial or lenient coverage, none a wholly ungraded requirement): (N1) behaviour.md:11 'within about five seconds' is graded with a ten-second window in cw_live_library_update ('watch its library for up to ten seconds') and cw_newer_revision_notice_keeps_draft; an app polling every 9 s passes. (N2) ui.md:11 'The current match is selected in the editor' is graded only as 'visibly marked as the current one' (cw_find_forward_backward_wrap); an app that highlights the match without making it the editor selection passes. (N3) ui.md:7 Shift+Tab outdent 'as one undoable action' and outdent of a selection inside a single line are not observed; cw_block_indent_undo checks Undo/Redo only for Tab and the inner-line case only for Tab. (N4) ui.md:5 'Shift with the arrow keys extends a selection' is observed only across one grapheme in cw_grapheme_navigation_and_deletion; multi-character or multi-line keyboard extension is not graded. (N5) ui.md:13 'Colouring ... must not change the saved source or preview result' is covered only for displayed text ('source text must stay exact'); no criterion runs or saves the coloured draft for that purpose, though other Run/Save criteria would normally expose it. (N6) overview.md:3 'Show the code editor, preview and console together' is graded only by the likert cw_visual_workspace_layout, which does not state simultaneous visibility as a bar; 'New drafts start empty or with a small example' has no criterion (permissive statement, nearly unfalsifiable). (N7) ui.md:17 focus back in the code after 'a replacement' is checked for Replace all only, not Replace current. (N8) The two workbook copies in the frozen rules differ in hash (rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx 6d44970b..., skill assets/WebDev_Rubrics_QC.xlsx d7b5d607...); row 26 text was read from the former; not a task defect.
